name: China Nerin Engineering Co., Ltd
summary: China Nerin Engineering Co., Ltd operates as an engineering technology company in China and internationally. It offers engineering and technical services, including design consulting engineering, procurement, construction, equipment integration, digital transformation, etc. for non-ferrous metal mining, smelting, and metal processing, as well as ecological environment governance and municipal infrastructure. The company was founded in 1986 and is based in Nanchang, China.
